messages.content: I see why you've tentatively placed this at Level 2, but the evidence coded shows detailed points on both contraception and infertility hormones, with roles and consequences linked quite clearly, which fits Level 3 criteria better. The linkage is mostly logical and the detail meets the requirement of covering both areas with explanations. So, I think the tentative Level 2 may under-represent the depth here, and a re-anchor toward Level 3 seems justified unless there are clarity or coherence issues not evident in the coded evidence. No key criteria appear missing from the evidence to support Level 3.
